issues.title: Ingest the San Francisco adopted budget
issues.detail: Total and departments for the consolidated city-county.
issues.learned: FY2026-27 all-funds budget $16,851,826,113 — Public Health $3.58B is the largest department, and self-supporting enterprises (Airport, PUC, Muni, Port) are much of the rest. General Fund $6.18B. One consolidated budget: SF is city and county at once.

issues.title: Department detail below the top line
issues.detail: The all-funds total is ingested by department; deeper program-level detail (divisions, grants) is the next layer.
